definitions.gloss: formal dress, ceremonial attire, formal wear
definitions.explanation: Clothing worn for formal occasions such as weddings, funerals, official ceremonies, or state events. Includes both Western formal wear and traditional Japanese formal kimono.

examples.japanese: {礼装|れいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{礼装|れいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Formal dress is required at weddings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{招待状|しょうたいじょう}→招待状：14769_shoutaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{礼装|れいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The invitation said, 'Please come in formal attire.'

notes:
USAGE:
Distinguished from ⟦{正装|せいそう}→正装：16053_seisou⟧ (full formal dress), which is the most formal level. {礼装|れいそう} covers a range from semi-formal to full formal. Japanese {礼装|れいそう} may include {紋付|もんつ}き⟦{袴|はかま}→袴：02245_hakama⟧ for men or ⟦{留袖|とめそで}→留袖：27624_tomesode⟧ for women.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {礼装|れいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dress formally
- {礼装|れいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend in formal wear
- {略礼装|りゃくれいそう}: semi-formal dress
- ⟦{和装|わそう}→和装：21261_wasou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{礼装|れいそう}: formal Japanese attire
